title: Edit Distance
prompt:
Given two strings `a` and `b`, return the minimum number of single-character edits needed to turn a into b. The allowed edits are: insert one character, delete one character, or replace one character with another. Treat the strings as sequences of chars.

Signature: `fn edit_distance(a: &str, b: &str) -> usize`

Example:
  edit_distance("kitten", "sitting") -> 3
  edit_distance("", "abc") -> 3
